book.name: 2 Koronti
book.title: Pwoo ɗevǝl dǝ Pool ran nen Koronti mo

content: Wen Pool shikáa fen, wen ɗang pee wun, mbǝ mǝse mu pǝɗok kǝ ɗeret mǝ Kristi. Wen ɗe moo sat nǝ, wen a nguɗokpwoo tǝktǝk, katɗang wen ashak kǝ wun, ɗang Nnee wen kǝn sat mbii mo nwun agaak, katɗang baa wen ashak kǝ wun kas.

Wen ɗang pee wun, mbǝkǝ taji wu le tǝng nwen satpwoo nwun shiɓal kas, katɗang wen jì pee wun ɗi. Mbǝɗe wen man azeen nǝ, wen mak satpwoo shiɓal nen ɗe moo sat nnǝ, mbii ɗe muu cìn sǝ ɓe nǝ a ɗak mǝ yil ɗesǝ.
Koo ɗe muu tong a nɗǝǝn yil nǝ, ɓe mbii ɗe mun nkaa cìn lek mbǝ nǝ, baa nǝ a mǝ yil ɗesǝ kas.
Leelek ɗe muu cìn lek ɗishik, baa nǝ a mǝ yil desǝ kas. Ɗang leelek fun nǝ a ɓal mǝ Naan, ɗe nǝn mmak shirip kok ɗeɓal mo.

Muu shirip pwoo kǝ nen ɗe moo jì kǝ mbii langkáa nkaa man Naan, kǝzak, muu shirip koo a kok mǝ roop ɗeɗangyi ɗe nǝ daam man Naan ngurum mo. Kǝ muu le kǝ koo a pan kǝ weyi, ɓe nǝ cìn ɗyen kǝ Kristi ɗi zak.
Aɓwoon ɗe wun nkám agaak azeen-nzeen nǝ, wuu kǝlǝng pwoo fun, bǝ mun ɗak sun fun rǝret mbǝ kar nencii kǝlǝngpee mo.
A mii le ɗang wuu leyit fuu mo nkaa mbii dǝ mo aɓwoon yi? Katɗang mee gurum kǝ leshin nnǝ, wuɗin a mǝ Kristi, ɓe nǝ ret kǝ wur pan rǝret, kǝ wur man nnǝ mun a mǝ Kristi zak.
Mbǝɗe koo dǝ wen canjoom ɗes shi ɓal ɗe Daa wur shin mmun, ɓe nǝ a mbǝkǝ mu ɗak wun ɗi, baa a mbǝkǝ mu shirip wun ɗi kas. Baa mee naashweep yaa wen kas.
Taji wu pan nǝ, wen kǝn gung a mbǝkǝ wen lekǝǝrmuut ɗi nwun shi ran fen nǝ mo kas.
Mbǝɗe pak gurum moo sat nǝ, mbii ɗe wur ran nɗǝǝn ran wur nǝ mo toon, kǝ mo ɓal zam, amma katɗang gurum naa wur nyit, bǝ baa shin wur nǝ kǝ mee ɓal kas. Pwoo ɗe wur sat nǝ, ɓe baa nǝ ke koop nǝ kas.
Nǝ ret kǝ nen sat pwoo mǝnǝ mo man nǝ, mbii ɗe muu sat nɗǝǝn ran, bǝ baa nǝ ɗyik kǝ mbii ɗe muu sat nwun nyit kǝ yit kas, katɗang mukaat ashak kǝ wun.
Baa mu mak lekáa fun, koo mu kámkáa fun mo nciit kǝ nen ɗe moo canjoom a shi sut fur mo kas. Mbǝɗe moo kám sut fur mo kǝ shak, kǝ moo camsut fur kǝ shak zak. Nen mǝnǝ mo a mwen mo.
Baa mun ncanjoom ɗel peeɗe nǝ ret kǝ mu ɗar ɗi kas. Amma mu ɗar a nkaa pee ɗak ɗe Naan wur kǝ can nǝ mmun, desǝ nǝ ɓal kǝ ɗak fun nnaar fu.
Wun a nɗǝǝn pee ɗak dǝ Naan wur kǝ can mun, akǝsǝ bǝ baa di mu canjoom mbǝ ɗak fun ɗik kas, kaaɗe gyet mu dǝm kǝ pwoo mǝ Kristi nǝ nwun sǝ.
Baa canjoom fun nǝ ɗel met mbii dǝ nǝ ret kas, kǝ baa nǝ tung ɗak ke mee gurum mo kas. Amma mu canciin nǝ, a shinzeen fuu nǝ ɓul hakyeng, ɓe ɗak fun nɗǝǝn wun, nǝn mɓul ɗes hakyeng zak.
Mbǝkǝ mu katpee satpwoo kǝ Naan ɗi nɗǝǝn yil ɗe mo a kyeen fuu. Baa mu canjoom a shi peeɗe mee gurum kǝ cam cìn ɗak ɗi kas.
Amma kaaɗe moo kǝ ran nɗǝǝn ɓǝǝt haal kǝ Naan sǝ nǝnee, <<Jir ngwe ɗe wur canjoom, bǝ nǝ ret kǝ wur canjoom nǝ a shi mbii ɗe Daa wur kǝ cìn.>>
Mbǝɗe baa Naan wur kǝ reɓet ngwe ɗe wur ke kwoop a shin kas, amma a ngwe ɗe Daa wur kǝ kwoop ɓejee.
